description: This file contains trigger decoder functions for Chrysler vehicles, including configuration for Dodge Ram, Neon 2003, Dodge Stratus, and Jeep XJ 4-cylinder, involving trigger shape initialization, event scheduling, and synchronization setup.

methods.name: initDodgeRam
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Dodge Ram with specific event timing and synchronization settings.

methods.name: configureNeon2003TriggerShapeCrank
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Neon 2003 crank sensor with multiple event timings based on mode multiplier.

methods.name: configureNeon2003TriggerShapeCam
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Neon 2003 cam sensor with primary or secondary channel event setup.

methods.name: configureNeon1995TriggerShapeOnlyCrank
methods.description: Configures Neon 1995 trigger shape for crank sensor only, with specific synchronization gap.

methods.name: configureNeon1995TriggerShape
methods.description: Configures Neon 1995 trigger shape for cam sensor with full event schedule.

methods.name: initJeep18_2_2_2
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Jeep 18 2 2 2 with specific secondary trigger events.

methods.name: initJeep_XJ_4cyl_2500
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape for Jeep XJ 4-cylinder 2500cc engine with multiple trigger blocks.
